title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：pronunciation　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pronunciation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the headmaster ① practised the pronunciation that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the practising was the whole of the year. The ② pronunciation, meaning the sound itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; pronunciation, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of pronunciation in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ pronunciation at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Pronunciation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the headmaster said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pronunciation was the whole of the matter, meaning the clarity and not the sound. The ⑥ pronunciation, meaning the clarity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pronunciation, he said, is either something you practise or the only word that means both sound and a clarity. He said the clarity is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ pronunciation had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ pronunciation of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of recording; pronunciation, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pronunciation I remember is the pronunciation recorded in the record, which closed in 1992 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Pronunciation, my mother said in 1994, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all pronunciation, she said, is a clarity that has agreed to look like sound. She said the clarity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 发音（指学堂里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 发音（指那种发音本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：practise the pronunciation 练这一种发音
D. n. 发音（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 发音之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的发音之事）
F. n. 发音（指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一种）
G. n. 发音、清楚（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清楚（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: practised the pronunciation that no student in the school would have recorded
The pronunciation, meaning the sound itself and not the bell
Every sort of pronunciation in that school
the pronunciation at the far gate
the pronunciation was the whole of the matter
the pronunciation had become a line in a record
The pronunciation of the whole thing

answers.why: practise the pronunciation 意为“练这一种发音”，1985 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯记载的一种发音做了一遍。
pronunciation 意为“发音”，指那种发音本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。
pronunciation 意为“发音”，指学堂里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
pronunciation 意为“发音”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pronunciation 意为“发音、清楚”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种清楚就是那件事的全部。
pronunciation 意为“清楚”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种发音，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pronunciation 意为“发音”，指学籍册里写到、被记载的那一种，到 1990 年这一种成了学籍册里的一行。
pronunciation 意为“发音之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的发音之事是一处学堂和三个学年的记载。
pronunciation 意为“发音”，我记得的是学籍册里记载过的那一种，1992 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一种。
pronunciation 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，发音是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的发音。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

那种发音，指的是那种发音本身而不是小小的铜铃，经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被记载。（pronunciation）
那处学堂里每一类发音旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。（pronunciation）
最远那道校门那种发音，指的是他们留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pronunciation）
叔叔说这种清楚就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种发音。（pronunciation）
1994 年母亲说，发音是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的发音。（pronunciation）
